effective_probability_rule.else_when_prior_Q1_streak_at_least_4: Q1 weight moves to Q2; original Q3 weight stays
effective_probability_rule.threshold_interpretation: after 12 committed non-Q3 drops, the next (13th) is Q3; after 4 committed Q1 drops, the next (5th) is at least Q2

quality_contract.material_draw: each committed material unit draws independently with replacement from current region weights; seed and result stored under same claim

manufacturing_contract.cost_reason: finite materials and copper are the cost; does not fabricate an action day or free workshop services
manufacturing_contract.registered_field_service_exception_ref: field_consumable_event_contract; ordinary town crafting remains town_only

consumable_use_contract.departure_pouch_rule: carried item units plus town-used pending next-battle preparation units <=4; used preparation unit keeps its reservation until expedition ends

upgrade_contract.resolve_materials: substitute primary_material_tag first, then sum duplicate tags before checking and debiting inventory

disassembly.resolve_materials: substitute primary tag and sum duplicate tags, e.g. EF04-Q3 returns crystal_shard 4

validation_limits: All numbers are prototype anchors. Budget and transaction examples do not establish combat balance or a complete campaign clear.
